Manufacturers across automotive, aerospace, construction, and industrial sectors are increasingly adopting battery-powered and cordless riveting tools to improve mobility, productivity, and operational flexibility. Advances in lithium-ion battery technology are enabling longer runtimes, higher pulling forces, and improved tool performance, making cordless systems a viable alternative to pneumatic equipment.
